description: The public, thread-safe right-hand side (issue #541): a program built once and evaluated with a caller-owned workspace and an immutable, epoch-stamped forcing set. Every comparison is BITWISE against the same binding's existing single-threaded evaluation (Rust debug_eval_rhs_into with a taped scratch; Julia the Problem's f!) or against the same program's own serial results. Generated by scripts/gen-public-rhs-program-manifest.py.

scope_excluded.python: No native program (API_SPEC §5.8): rhs_program, forcing_set and default_forcing_set raise compiler_unavailable, which pkg/earthsci-ast-py/tests/test_public_rhs_program.py asserts for the first case.

generator.name: hash01
generator.fnv1a32: FNV-1a, 32-bit: offset basis 0x811c9dc5, prime 0x01000193, over the UTF-8 bytes of key
generator.note: The same function as tests/conformance/range_restricted_rhs (there keyed by the bare variable name). Here the key carries a prefix naming what is drawn.

draws.u: element k (1-based, column-major over the declared shape; 1 for a 0-d state) of state block v in draw d: 0.5 + h("u<d>/<v>", k)
draws.p: draw 0: parameter_vector(prog, {}) (the defaults); draw d >= 1: parameter named n is 0.5 + h("p<d>/<n>", 1), passed through parameter_vector as overrides
draws.aux: empty (every program in this suite is whole-domain)

forcing_sets.D: default_forcing_set(prog) / RhsProgram::default_forcing(): must equal the case's default_forcing bitwise
forcing_sets.A: element k (1-based, column-major) of slot s: 0.5 + h("fA/<s>", k), one buffer per forcing_slots entry
forcing_sets.B: replace_forcing(A, replace_slot, buf) / A.replace(..): buf element k is 0.5 + h("fB/<replace_slot>", k); every other buffer is A's

concurrency.tasks: every (draw, set) pair, sets D, A, B (fault case: the ok_state and the draws, set D)
concurrency.pick: call j (1-based) of thread q (1-based) evaluates task floor(h("c<q>", j) * n_tasks) + 1

history_order: task i (1-based) of the full task list is evaluated in the order of ascending h("order", i), ties by i

cases.note: An existing document: a 1-D field fed by a data source with a scalar default, read straight into du. No provider is bound, so the default is the Problem's forcing.
2-D gridded forcing read through state-free observeds (a contraction and a quotient), a 1-D forcing times state, scalar parameters, t, and a zero ghost.

An existing document: two shaped parameters, one with a scalar default broadcast over its shape and one with an array default. With the option on both are ArrayParameter slots; with it off neither is a slot and both are baked.
A const-array read at a subscript computed from the state w: in range for w < 5, past the end (index 8) at w = 7.5. No forcing: the empty forcing set is a valid argument.
